name: tr_martin
caption:
IF ALIJAH MARTIN HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🏈 Tauros: once it starts running, it won't stop. 2,100 passing yards and 1,300 rushing yards as a high school senior
🦉 Noctowl: sees in the dark, never lets its prey escape. Helped Florida Atlantic to its first ever Final Four
🐊 Feraligatr: huge jaws, and blinding speed when it attacks. 2025 national champion with the Florida Gators
♟️ Pawniard: trains hard, dreaming of one day taking the lead. Our pick 39, on a two-way deal
👊 Scrafty: guards its turf and never leaves it. G League All-Defensive Team and All-League Third Team
🔥 Charizard: breathes fire hot enough to melt boulders. 27 points at Milwaukee on 6-of-7 from three, 53.3% from three through 9 games

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Alijah Martin had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF MARTIN HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Tauros. Once it starts running, it won't stop. In high school, he threw for twenty-one hundred yards and ran for thirteen hundred.
beats.dlg: IT CHARGES AND WON'T STOP.|2,100 PASS, 1,300 RUSH YDS

beats.vo: Noctowl. It sees in the dark and never lets its prey escape. He helped take the Florida Atlantic Owls to their first Final Four ever.
beats.dlg: IT SEES IN THE DARK.|FAU'S FIRST FINAL FOUR!

beats.vo: Feraligatr. Huge jaws, and blinding speed when it attacks. He transferred to Florida, and won the national title in twenty twenty-five.
beats.dlg: HUGE JAWS, BLINDING SPEED.|2025 NATIONAL CHAMPION!

beats.vo: Pawniard. It trains hard, dreaming of one day taking the lead. We took him thirty-ninth, on a two-way deal.
beats.dlg: TRAINS TO TAKE THE LEAD.|PICK 39, A TWO-WAY DEAL.

beats.vo: Scrafty. It guards its turf and never leaves it. In the G League last season: All-Defensive Team, and All-League Third Team.
beats.dlg: IT GUARDS ITS TURF.|ALL-D, ALL-LEAGUE 3RD TEAM

beats.vo: And the ace. Charizard. Fire hot enough to melt boulders. Twenty-seven at Milwaukee, six of seven from three, and fifty-three point three percent from deep through nine games.
beats.dlg: FIRE THAT MELTS BOULDERS.|27 AT MILWAUKEE, 6 OF 7!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: High school senior season as quarterback: passed for 2,100 yards and rushed for 1,300 yards; helped lead Florida Atlantic to the school's first ever Final Four; transferred to Florida, NCAA champion (2025); selected 39th overall (#39) by Toronto in the 2025 NBA draft, signed to a two-way contract; All-NBA G League Third (3rd) Team (2026), NBA G League All-Defensive Team (2026)
